description: Add six more colours through COPY rather than INSERT.
rationale: copy_rows is the one row kind that is never paced and cannot be: a COPY whose second row violates a constraint rolls back all of them, so it is one transaction whatever its size. Six rows is well inside that. No color_id is supplied here -- the identity column generates them, which is why this depends on 0072: if COPY ran first the sequence would hand out 1 to 6 and the explicit ids in the seed would then collide.
